description.value: Sparky Chicken is a Korean fried chicken shop on Fraser Street in Vancouver, specializing in a wide variety of sauced and grilled chicken dishes served with pickled radish and tteok (rice cake). The menu spans bone-in and boneless options in flavours from honey garlic to extreme hot, plus Korean rice bowls and samgak kimbap. Takeout and delivery are both available, making it a convenient stop for a hearty meal on a Fraser Street cycling route.
